centralMetadataChanges.change: Replace MX/deliverability claims with: Validate unquoted ASCII email address syntax locally. This tool does not check DNS, MX records, mailbox existence, or deliverability.

Replace full-collision/MD5 attack claims with: Demonstrate the birthday paradox by finding matching truncated SHA-1 or SHA-256 prefixes. This does not find full-length collisions or break these algorithms.

Describe composition heuristics and obvious-pattern checks, not measured entropy or crack-time prediction. Random-model bits are a theoretical upper bound for independently sampled characters. No breach lookup.

Describe current-time UUID v1 with random multicast node and cryptographic randomness. Remove lexicographically/chronologically sortable UUID-string claims: v1 field layout does not sort globally by time.
Update supported version digits to 1–8 plus special Nil and Max UUIDs; version comes from third group and RFC variant is required for versions 1–8.
Limit advertised tables to printable ASCII 32–126, common HTML entities, URI-component escaping and Base64 alphabet. No UTF-8 cross-reference table is implemented.
Clarify OpenSSH public-key line plus unencrypted PKCS8 PEM private key. Do not promise all SSH clients accept PKCS8, particularly Ed25519; conversion may be necessary.
Verify surrounding copy states CSPRNG randomness and timestamp ordering; do not claim monotonic increments within a millisecond.

limitations: Web Crypto requires a supported secure browser context; unsupported algorithms show errors rather than simulated output.
SSH private format is PKCS8, not an OpenSSH private container.
Data URI file mode deliberately accepts arbitrary bytes and preserves the browser-provided MIME hint; it does not claim to validate the internal file format.
Encodings Reference Clear resets the filter; reference table content intentionally remains.
Bcrypt in-flight work cannot be interrupted inside bcryptjs; revision guards prevent stale results from returning after Clear.
integration: Commit contains only assigned components, new developer-security helpers/frame/tests and the group case/report files. Dependency symlink remains untracked. No push, merge, build or dev server.
